asr.full_text: Bitcoin, the experimental online currency, is now a global one, complete with its own and so far only ATM. And the first machine has been set up in a café in Vancouver, where people can exchange digital money for physical cash. But, though, you're probably asking yourself exactly what are bitcoins? In the simplest terms, it's just a currency but an online one. Bitcoins are stored in web wallets that are completely Anonymous lacking even your name, though the transactions are public Bits can be sent from one wallet to another Adjust the click of a button and in most cases with no fees or delay the system by passes banks Middlemen and governments what's more bitcoins can be easily sold for any Currency available finally though. Where do they come from? The process is called Bitcoin mining and consists of computers running special programs to generate a steady flow of currency Jeffrey Albert Gukka from the Foundation for Economic Education He caused the currencies rise simply spectacular. A year ago this time, I thought it was insane. I mean, I thought, well, this is just another stupid technology. They come along every few days and they flame out. So I'm a fairly recent convert. The more I look into it, the more confident I'm getting that the future of the world monetary system is cryptography and this kind of crypto market based currency it's quite spectacular. And I tell you it only takes a few times using Bitcoin to realize this is incredibly easy it's much much easier than credit cards and there's no danger of fraud or identity theft all these other things that come with it the old fashioned credit card system its just a superior technology. And Bitcoin exchanges and brokers have popped up all over the world. Even China's largest search engine now accepts payments in the digital currency. We were also told it could well become the dominant legal tender. Really, it's formulated to be an alternative currency, and there's no reason why it can't itself become a means of calculation, so you can do your accounting in it, in fact people do this all the time, and you can enter into the Bitcoin ecosphere and, and live a wonderful life. Meaning that you can bypass a government currency entirely, cryptocurrency. Now it may be popular in demand

The recruitment request is paired with success- and trading-oriented language, presenting a crypto-branded solicitation for viewer participation rather than only a neutral discussion. The sampled spoken and visual content mainly explains Bitcoin, so the available video evidence does not establish One Coin's enrollment steps, payment requirements, promised returns, or transaction outcomes.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary evidence explicitly invites viewers to contact a named person to join a 'team builder', which supports a recruitment/team-structure mechanism. The records do not establish downline commissions, tiers, payment requirements, or earning dependence, so the fit is limited to the observed recruitment structure.
